mcbaseball.guide.title: How to Play
mcbaseball.guide.0.title: The Goal
mcbaseball.guide.0.1: Score more runs than the other team.
mcbaseball.guide.0.2: Hit the ball, then run around the bases: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, then HOME.
mcbaseball.guide.0.4: Your team bats until it gets 3 outs. Then you switch and play defense.
mcbaseball.guide.0.5: Most runs after the last inning wins.
mcbaseball.guide.1.title: Start a Game
mcbaseball.guide.1.2: 2. Field Setup > Build Field For Me. Or place an Instant Stadium block for a whole ballpark.
mcbaseball.guide.1.4: You can play alone: NPCs fill every empty spot on both teams.
mcbaseball.guide.1.5: Friends join with Play for HOME / Play for AWAY before you press START.
mcbaseball.guide.2.title: Batting
mcbaseball.guide.2.1: You're given a bat. Stand still and watch the pitcher.
mcbaseball.guide.2.2: A ring appears where the ball will reach you. When it shrinks onto the ball and turns green: Left-Click!
mcbaseball.guide.2.3: Point your crosshair at the ball. Aim too high or low and you miss.
mcbaseball.guide.2.4: Swing early = ball goes left. Late = goes right.
mcbaseball.guide.2.5: Don't swing at pitches outside the white box: 4 of those = a free walk to 1st.
mcbaseball.guide.2.6: 3 strikes = you're out. After a hit, RUN to 1st!
mcbaseball.guide.3.title: Pitching
mcbaseball.guide.3.1: Press R to choose a pitch: fastballs are fast, curveballs drop, sliders slide.
mcbaseball.guide.3.2: Aim your crosshair at the white box. A green circle shows where you're aiming.
mcbaseball.guide.3.4: Let go in the green = fast and accurate. Bad timing = the pitch goes wild.
mcbaseball.guide.3.5: Inside the box = strike if they don't swing. Outside = ball.
mcbaseball.guide.3.6: Tip: pitches just outside the box trick batters into swinging.
mcbaseball.guide.4.title: Fielding
mcbaseball.guide.4.1: You get a glove automatically. Face the ball and let it come to you.
mcbaseball.guide.4.2: Fly ball? Run to the yellow ring on the ground and catch it before it lands: that's an out.
mcbaseball.guide.4.3: Hold Right-Click and let go to throw where you're looking.
mcbaseball.guide.4.4: Holding the ball and standing on a base the runner HAS to reach = out.
mcbaseball.guide.4.5: Or Left-Click a runner who is off his base = tag out.
mcbaseball.guide.4.6: Not sure what to do? Read the yellow line at the top of your screen.
mcbaseball.guide.5.title: Running the Bases
mcbaseball.guide.5.1: After you hit, run to 1st and touch it.
mcbaseball.guide.5.2: On a base you're safe. Between bases you can be tagged.
mcbaseball.guide.5.3: Fly ball caught in the air? Go back and touch your base first.
mcbaseball.guide.5.4: Sprint, then press Sneak near a base to slide (harder to tag).
mcbaseball.guide.5.5: Follow the yellow line at the top: it tells you when to run and when to stay.
mcbaseball.guide.6.title: The Four Outs
mcbaseball.guide.6.2: Fly out: the ball is caught before it touches the ground.
mcbaseball.guide.6.3: Force out: the runner had to run to a base and a fielder with the ball got there first.
mcbaseball.guide.6.4: Tag out: a fielder with the ball touches a runner who isn't on a base.
mcbaseball.guide.6.5: Foul ball: hit outside the chalk lines. Counts as a strike (but never the 3rd).
